title: 805 Offsec Learn Enterprise Subscription
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR COMBAT COMMAND.FA4861  99 CONS LGC
description_text: The 805 CTS located at Nellis AFB, NV requires access to Offensive Security's enterprise training platform and the PEN-200 course for six users for one year. The Penetration Testing with Kali Linux (PEN-200) course is a comprehensive training program offered by Offensive Security (OffSec) for aspiring penetration testers and cybersecurity professionals. This requirement is brand name only. Please see attachment for details.
